QuestInfo.name: Huge Creature of the Snowfield
QuestInfo.0: #p2020006# from #m211000000# was attacked by a huge yeti in the snowfield a while ago. Let's go and hear about this attack from #p2020006#.
QuestInfo.1: #p2020006# says that he was attacked by a huge yeti while skiing in the snowy mountains of El Nath. What could have attacked #p2020006#? #b#p2020007##k knows a lot about snowfield creatures. Let's go and ask about them.
QuestInfo.2: Asked #p2020007# about the creature that attacked #p2020006#. #p2020007# seems to know something about the creature.

0.0: I can still feel my heart thumping.\r\n#b#L0#I heard you've been through a lot these days.#l
0.1: Yes, indeed! I had this sudden urge to see the beautiful snowfield scenery, so I went to #bEl Nath Mountain Range#b. However, I was attacked by a huge creature there.\r\n#b#L0#What kind of creature?#l
0.2: You may not believe me, but I saw a huge Yeti on skis, wearing a woolen hat! \r\n#b#L0#Y-Yeti?#l
0.3: Yes! You may think me strange, but I really saw one with my very two eyes! Nobody seems to believe me. Ah, right! He might know something about the creature. Please go and meet him.

yes.0: Hunter #b#p2020007##k has been hunting this snowfield for a long time, and is bound to know something about the creature. Please go meet #b#p2020007##k.

no.0: You don't believe me, do you? You're no different from the rest of them! I just know he will believe in me... he's the only one who can prove I'm not a liar.

1.0: Umm... why have you come?\r\n#b#L0#I have something to ask you.#l
1.1: Don't know what you'd have to say to me, but hurry up.\r\n#b#L0#(Told Scadur of #p2020006#'s story.)#l
1.2: Hmm... He was wearing ski boots, right?

npc.0: Hunter #b#p2020007##k will know what that creature was.
